# HYPHSWORLD security reporting

AMS WEST operates HYPHSWORLD.com. We welcome responsible reports about the
public HYPHSWORLD website, account access, creator features, games, and digital
music checkout/download flows.

## Report a concern privately

Email **tone@amsenterprisecorp.com** with the subject
**HYPHSWORLD SECURITY REPORT**, or use
[the website's security contact page](https://hyphsworld.com/security.html).

Include the affected page or feature, a description of the behavior, and
steps to reproduce it **without** disclosing personal data or secrets.
Screenshots should not contain passwords, API keys, payment information,
authentication tokens, or other people's data.

**Please do not post exploitable details in public GitHub issues or discussions.**

## Responsible testing boundaries

- Use only accounts and data you own or have explicit authorization to test.
- Do not access, download, alter, or disclose someone else's information.
- Do not perform denial-of-service tests, phishing, social engineering,
  payment fraud, or testing that disrupts HYPHSWORLD's live customers.
- Stop if you encounter unexpected sensitive information and report it privately.
- Give AMS WEST a reasonable opportunity to investigate before public disclosure.

We cannot promise a particular response time, monetary reward, or legal safe
harbor. There is currently **no public bug bounty program**.

This reporting policy is not a third-party security certification.

Website disclosure address: https://hyphsworld.com/.well-known/security.txt
